verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples for Gram's own API, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec at any candidate path. The in-dashboard agent harness for testing MCP servers is a different feature: it lets users chat with tools, not explore an API reference, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
